name: OpenTune Demo (synthetic EDC16)

sources: synthetic: generated by samples/generate.py (no real ECU data)

notes: SYNTHETIC DEMO ONLY - NOT a real ECU. Pairs with samples/opentune-demo-edc16.bin, a 64 KiB fabricated image carrying one valid EDC16 MPC56x checksum directory block ([0x0100..0x7FFF], sum == 0xD01FE500) plus one calibration map and fake identity strings. Use it to exercise Analyze / Identify / Checksum verify+fix / Map-decode offline. Every address and value here is made up; do not flash anything from it.

maps.name: injection quantity limiter (demo)
maps.notes: SYNTHETIC. 8x16-bit cells at 0x2000, rising monotonically with air mass (X) and engine speed (Y). Decodes to ~14..53 mg/stroke. Axes are stored in-image; see the .bin generator in the repo history.
